title: Doris Mee Demonstrates
paragraphs: Free Artist Demonstration by Doris Mee – Saturday, August 17, 2:00 p.m. to 4 p.m. at the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists, Harwich Port.
Girl in the Garden by Doris Mee

On Saturday August 17, 2-4pm, the Guild of Harwich Artists Art Gallery ‘Meet the Artist’ series features Doris Mee. Doris will present her method for painting and assembling her award-winning unique mixed media/collage paintings. She uses a wide variety of papers, which she hand-paints in watercolor or acrylic in preparation for assembling her collage. Several of her newest paintings will be displayed at the Guild’s Art Gallery 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) Harwich Port. The public is welcome – light refreshments will be served.
The Art Gallery is now open all week, Monday-Saturday 10:00 a.m. -5:00 p.m. and Sunday 12:00 p.m.- 4:00 p.m. Free parking is available at the visitor center directly across the street.

Doris will present her method for painting and assembling her award-winning unique mixed media/collage paintings. She uses a wide variety of papers, which she hand-paints in watercolor or acrylic in preparation for assembling her collage.  Several of her newest paintings will be displayed at the Guild’s Art Gallery 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) Harwich Port. The public is welcome – light refreshments will be served.

The Art Gallery is now open all week, Monday-Saturday 10:00 a.m. -5:00 p.m. and Sunday 12:00 p.m.- 4:00 p.m. Free parking is available at the visitor center directly across the street.
